name: get_course
description: The school's course in this village's language and where Jan is in it: the classroom (the day the class began, with Zaselek; null: not yet, or a village whose school stood first), the school's level (null: not built), and per level (A1, A2, B1, B2 …) whether it is open and its units done; per unit its intro (steps done/of, intro_done), its worksheets done/of and the best try of each sheet (right/of, almost), the test (pass mark, best try, tries), the day it was done (tested_out: passed without the worksheets; placed: marked done by the placement test) and your homework ids; next: the first unit to do. placement (left out when none): the placement test the learner took (its day, the level before and the one it set, where the school went on, the units it marked). Planned units are listed, not playable yet. looked_up (left out when none): the grammar pages Jan looked up on the cheat sheet during exercises in the last two weeks, most first (page, title, n answers given with one of its cards open, the last day, units: the course's units that teach it): work potential, suggest the unit or homework on it.
